name: agent_client_update
_description: PLAN V1.0 Bloque 8 - Resumen semanal automatizado al cliente. Webhook POST /api/v1/agents/client-update/run con JWT. Carga activity+visits+incidents de la semana, llama gpt-4o-mini, INSERT client_weekly_updates (draft), notifica al arquitecto por Gmail con link de approve.

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok
),
defaults AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE($4::date, (date_trunc('week', now())::date - INTERVAL '7 days')::date) AS ws,
    COALESCE($4::date, (date_trunc('week', now())::date - INTERVAL '7 days')::date) + INTERVAL '6 days' AS we
),
proj AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, p.current_phase, p.location_city, p.tenant_id,
         c.name AS client_name, c.email AS client_email
  FROM projects p
  JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id, ctx
  WHERE p.id = $5::uuid
  LIMIT 1
),
act AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'agent_name', al.agent_name, 'action', al.action,
    'created_at', al.created_at, 'message_type', al.message_type
  ) ORDER BY al.created_at), '[]'::json) AS items
  FROM activity_log al, defaults d
  WHERE al.project_id = $5::uuid
    AND al.created_at >= d.ws::timestamptz
    AND al.created_at < (d.we + INTERVAL '1 day')::timestamptz
),
visits AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'visit_date', svh.visit_date, 'acuerdos', svh.acuerdos,
    'observations', svh.observations
  ) ORDER BY svh.visit_date), '[]'::json) AS items
  FROM site_visit_acts svh, defaults d
  WHERE svh.project_id = $5::uuid
    AND svh.visit_date::date BETWEEN d.ws AND d.we
    AND svh.status IN ('approved','signed')
),
incs AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'description', pi.description, 'severity', pi.severity, 'status', pi.status,
    'cost_delta_eur', pi.cost_delta_eur, 'time_delta_days', pi.time_delta_days
  ) ORDER BY pi.detected_at), '[]'::json) AS items
  FROM project_incidents pi, defaults d
  WHERE pi.project_id = $5::uuid
    AND pi.detected_at::date BETWEEN d.ws AND d.we
)
SELECT
  proj.id AS project_id, proj.name AS project_name, proj.current_phase,
  proj.location_city, proj.client_name, proj.client_email, proj.tenant_id,
  d.ws AS week_start, d.we AS week_end,
  act.items AS activity, visits.items AS visits, incs.items AS incidents
FROM proj, defaults d, act, visits, incs;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_client_update', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO client_weekly_updates (
  tenant_id, project_id, week_start, week_end, summary_text, photos_referenced, status, created_at
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::date, $4::date, $5, $6::jsonb, 'draft', now()
)
ON CONFLICT (project_id, week_start) DO UPDATE SET
  summary_text = EXCLUDED.summary_text,
  photos_referenced = EXCLUDED.photos_referenced,
  week_end = EXCLUDED.week_end,
  status = 'draft',
  approved_by = NULL,
  approved_at = NULL,
  sent_at = NULL,
  email_message_id = NULL
RETURNING id, week_start, week_end, status, created_at;
